author: root Codex substantive mechanism design, protocol reasoning and critical acceptance
name: 跨设备后验读许可认领，单缺口尾读回退
real_problem: The current shared-read join requires both own READ results first. A second DMA with a cold/pending own translation misses already returned same-source data even though the issuer is fully authorized.
new_actions_relative_to_current_fixture: Before issuer V source AR, freeze pending original A READ identity and reserve bounded quarantine capacity; an untrusted same-object hint chooses capture only.
Copy contiguous existing V return data into invisible owned history while A own READ is still pending. Never issue an A predicted physical memory read.

Keep A independent physical dispatch unoffered until actual own READ result is verified against original identity/access, PA span, attributes, valid context generation and trusted source order/snapshot window.

On match, adopt retained prefix as original A response exactly once. On mismatch discard before any logical commitment and perform A normal own read. On permission fault discard and report real job error.

At first missed issuer word, detach permanently for this generation. If a prefix is already committed, issue only one unserved contiguous source suffix; never rejoin after a gap or replay already committed offsets.
Every destination W remains separately authorized. Complete each physical true WLAST/B and the one original logical RLAST/descriptor ACK honestly.
order_contract: Initial scope is trusted immutable stable Normal source covering sample through adoption, with A original read already eligible/pending before V sampling; no MMIO/atomic/exclusive, overlapping source writes, remap or revocation during reuse. Descriptor acceptance or untrusted hint alone is not this contract.

storage_choice.initial_honest_implementation: Explicit separate bounded history feeding the normal iDMA response path; its payload and metadata are additional charged storage, alongside existing DMA FIFO.
storage_choice.possible_later_same_Q: Existing private FIFO raw-load/adopt could avoid extra payload slots only after a real interface is implemented that stores without logical R progress and adopts resident bytes without a second push. Current production does not establish this interface.
storage_choice.state: Original READ cookie/context/extent/order; issuer provenance and snapshot generation; captured/adopted cursors, reserved capacity and permanent gap; own successful READ grant and source suffix child ownership; separate WRITE/B/error obligations.
storage_choice.cost: Capture/read ports, compare/dispatch muxes, source-response reassembly, real failed-job path, permission/invalidation retention and source stability administration all charged. No LUT/energy/timing reduction measured.

count_bound.scope: One original source envelope within one own READ region and AXI max/boundary, issuer AR1 and requester at most one contiguous fallback suffix.
count_bound.match: With p contiguous issuer words reused, data_R = N + (N-p) = 2N-p; source_AR<=2, logical_R=2N, real_W=2N.
count_bound.mismatch: Before requester logical commitment, discard then requester N: data_R=2N and source_AR=2. Capture creates no physical memory read.
count_bound.interpretation: Count conservation is not an independent novelty theorem; a fully specified history replay control with these same new interfaces obtains the same bound.

positive_and_neighbors.early_match: C protocol hand timeline: N8/Q3, A real READ grant accepted6 after issuer words2,5. Correct adoption and capacity enable full reuse; sourceR8, logicalR16, realW16; A ACK27/V ACK29 with four true AW/B each. These are illustrative events, not DUT timing.
positive_and_neighbors.serial_cold_default: A leaf queued behind V full burst cannot validate during that burst under the actual default model. Capture at most retained prefix J, then reuse J plus independent suffix; e.g. J3,N8 gives physicalR13, sourceAR2, compared with full independentR16.
positive_and_neighbors.late: Miss word4 with prefix3 held: no arbitrary tail join; verify then prefix3 plus physical suffix5.
positive_and_neighbors.wrong: Different own PA/attrs/order: discard before exposing A data; normal independent own read.
positive_and_neighbors.fault: No A logical data/target W from failed own READ; genuine error completion required, not current NO_ERROR success.
positive_and_neighbors.unproven: Full-copy benefit including extra history/control, realistic workload overlap, native grant timing and failure/revocation implementation remains unmeasured.

strong_control_and_novelty.complete_control: C fixed bounded source-prefix history with permission-checked replay is protocol-equivalent at the same abstract fields/interfaces/capacity. It uses newly proposed raw adoption/pre-VALID decision/tail reassembly interfaces; it is not proof that a published or existing production baseline has them.
strong_control_and_novelty.exact_known: SpecTLB speculation/validation and InvisiSpec/SafeSpec shadow reuse cover individual ideas, including no second hierarchy access. Renaming them for IOMMU is not a new algorithm.
strong_control_and_novelty.possible_architecture_contribution: 如果准确最近前作缺少跨DID自身许可与原DMA完成合同，而我们提供可达、低代价、可验证的后验认领接口并说明其有用能力，就可以把该接口与恢复协议作为架构贡献；必须计入实际缓冲/失效/错误/顺序成本。
strong_control_and_novelty.cannot_claim: 因为简单完整history控制取得相同计数与手例，不能把本卡的R减少界或例子称为对它的独有调度收益；因为零新增槽尚无实际raw-adopt接口，也不能声称零缓冲成本。
strong_control_and_novelty.SDM_boundary: SDM PACT2023 already overlaps data with permission checks and handles violations with replay/session isolation; its evaluation assumes all speculation succeeds. Root rule instead speculates only retention of already authorized issuer data, exposes no requester logical R/W before its own grant, and never starts a requester predicted physical read. Combined independent-DID/original-AXI/error/order contract is the precise comparison target; this is not yet a firstness conclusion.

next_gate: Choose one real source-READ interception/native successful-grant endpoint; specify a separately charged history and original tail-response contract. Compare matched, different-PA and denied-permission cases to SDM-style access-before-permit and actual read-ready history. If the full contract adds useful capability at honest cost and is absent from closest primary implementation, advance one focused model; otherwise redesign. Serial-cold default must be included, with no assumed early PTE interleave.
execution: Design and direct source/primary reading only; no new simulator, RTL, build or board.
